releases.displayName: Major update with game issues fixes

items.text: Fixed fields getting stuck in pH adjustment or nitrogen fertilization when the target soil conditions had already been reached.
Fixed crop rotation retaining the previous crop’s plants when switching species after perennial hibernation.
Fixed regrowing crops on joined fields being partially skipped during subsequent harvests.

Fixed feed quality being calculated from remaining supplies instead of the food actually consumed. Eating the last available portion now contributes correctly to meal quality for livestock and working animals.
Added checks for missing parking, livestock trailers, and compatible attachment points before livestock transport begins.
Fixed unused resource reservations remaining locked after certain delivery tasks ended or were canceled.
Fixed mixed-resource deliveries stopping loading before reaching the vehicle’s capacity.
Fixed a reservation calculation that could exceed the transport load limit.
Corrected season detection on African maps, where African seasons could be incorrectly treated as spring.
Fixed harvest timing checks incorrectly blocking watering, spraying, and ongoing crop care on tropical maps.
Corrected handling of perennial crops in Africa.
Fixed manual baling incorrectly requiring permission to operate machinery.
Fixed newly joined field sections receiving incorrect soil moisture values.
Fixed overlapping collection tasks counting the same bale more than once.
Added protection against collecting the same hay pile more than once.
Improved bale collection stability when previously selected bale objects have been removed.
Fixed animal animation controllers not switching correctly when young animals become adults.
Improved model visibility updates when animals transition to adulthood.
Prevented missing animal models or trailer display points from interrupting livestock deliveries.
Added cleanup for abandoned trader visits with missing buyers or vehicles, allowing subsequent automatic trade visits to proceed.
Fixed deliveries ignoring additional storage space provided by warehouse capacity upgrades.
Improved resource reservation ownership so one task cannot collect or release goods reserved for another task.
Fixed reservation totals being calculated from only the largest batch instead of all reserved batches.
Improved reservation cleanup across warehouses, production storage, and central storage.
Prevented field-task cleanup from removing reservations belonging to active deliveries.
Fixed automatic warehouse sales taking more stock than requested or continuing after the requested sale had been completed.
Fixed warehouse sales potentially skipping available stock spread across multiple batches.
Fixed animal-powered mills becoming unable to assign working animals after loading a save with no animals assigned.
Improved loading of animal-powered buildings with missing animals, duplicate animal references, or fewer assigned workers.
Fixed animal-powered buildings losing production recipes, progress, and settings when saving.
Improved trader cleanup following interrupted visits or errors during travel and trading.
Fixed older saves failing to initialize missing market entries for newly added resources and animals.
Fixed sorting by demand leaving resource lists empty when demand information was missing, including the multiplayer manager.
Added the Medium Shed to the African campaign’s building availability lists. Its training requirement remains in place.
Enabled the organic sugar refinery recipe, producing organic white sugar and organic molasses from organic sugarcane.
Fixed warehouse warnings being cleared for the wrong product or unrelated buildings.
Fixed warehouse warnings remaining active despite sufficient space in a suitable nearby warehouse.
Improved warehouse warnings to retain the required storage amount and display the suggested warehouse type.
Fixed transformer connections disagreeing with the displayed coverage area on slopes and at the edge of their range.
Corrected several Spanish tutorial messages that displayed text belonging to different objectives.
Added automatic retries for Steam achievement unlocks when Steam is not ready or an unlock submission fails.
Added account-specific storage for pending achievement unlocks so they can be retried after restarting the game.
Added 16 new languages: Bulgarian, Czech, Danish, Finnish, Greek, Spanish (Latin Americas), Dutch, Indonesian, Norwegian, Portuguese, Romanian, Swedish, Thai, Ukrainian, Vietnamese, Hungarian
Farm Owner's House will now properly unassign all workers automatically when assigning workers to Logistic Building
Porter's Hut logistics should now correctly guide pack animals to get resources
Working Pack Animals should now be able to die
Staff Manager should now show correct values
Production Manager should now show correct values
Animal Manager should now show correct values

Fixed issue where Resource Order warning, required amount could not update properly

Added possibility to replace roads by other types of roads
Some changes and additions to help center

Fixed issue where market orders could take wrong amounts
Fixed issue where autotrade with empty animal building would save incorrect animal
Fixed issue where autotrade could order double amount of animals
Fixed issue with Slaughterhouse forgetting orders
Adjusted buildings projections on grid
Fixed issue where Ox could not be used properly in Logistic Building
Fixed issue where fertilizing pH could block future field work
Fixed blocker in Africa campaign related to not being able to buy more terrain
Fixed incorrect Spanish translations
Fixed issue that caused machine panels at Field modal to not show tooltips and lead to machine market if pressed
Fixed issue where task related to having baby animals wouldn't count in some cases
Fixed issue where moving Vet or Repair Shop (Mechanic) buildings would not move their vehicles
Fixed issue where Vet could visit same building second time for the same reason even after his work was completed
Fixed issue where moving buildings didn't properly update their positions (vehicles traveling to old positions)
Optimized size of updates
Added information when Decoration Category is empty
Some fixes related to market and contracts
Fixed issues with Decoration Building panels duplicating
Fixed issue where staff in animals building would walk through walls when called for resource delivery
Perennial and Multi Harvest Plats should now have proper Growth after planting for the first time

Fixed issue with double f$ sign on Build Warehouse button text
Fixed Highlights for Camera icon in Europe Campaign Tutorial
Added tooltip (logistics-required) to Give Resources task in Africa campaign
Textile Factory and Composting Facility should be in every campaign now
Fixed issue where player region in multiplayer would change on its own
Fixed Malva pudding missing translation in one of Africa campaign text

More fertilizer available in the market

Restored tobaco seeds

Decorations are now sorted with new categories tabs

Allowing to build on decorations

notes.title: We bring to you 7 new resources

items.text: Waste
Compost
Linen Fabric
Cotton Fabric
Jute Fabric
Wool felt
Alpaca wool flannel: Your spoiled crops change now into Waste, which can be processed into our first new building!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44300664/0b848d79ec2aec18c3750bcf8952f330c279277f.png"]
Allows you to create Compost, a new type of fertilizer. And of course, you can use it on your fields or sell it to other farmers.
You can unlock it by completing the “Nothing Goes to Waste” Training.
You can check when your crops will change into Waste in the Plant Compendium under Product expires.
Choose up to 5 different fabrics to create in your own
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44300664/5b7cfcb3236797a1d7cd9e912f85438dd9a8141f.png"]
You're just one Training (“Light Industry”) away from being able to create beautiful textiles
Flax ➡️ Linen Fabric
Cotton ➡️Cotton Fabric
Jute ➡️ Jute Fabric
Sheep Wool ➡️ Wool felt
Alpaca Wool ➡️Alpaca wool flannel
To hone your skills, we created two scenarios focused on new buildings.
The Promised Land
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44300664/87e491d75e48a4c17ace8fac59758fb6a8da6b88.png"]
Nothing dies, everything returns[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44300664/1beb6f7f52a7c9d99f80b176b2d080a9eee221a9.png"]
After completing them, you’ll earn two new Achievements.
We warmly invite you to play, review, stream, and share your videos using #farmmanagerworld #TimeToFarm🌾
Besides that, we are consistently listening to your feedback on our Discord and Steam.

notes.title: ➡️The 1.0 patch for Farm Manager World is now live!⬅️

items.text: But that’s not all — we’re not stopping here! We are preparing new content, including new machines and other surprises! 🎁
We warmly invite you to play, review, stream, and share your videos using #farmmanagerworld #TimeToFarm🌾

notes.title: What will you find new in Farm Manager Word that wasn't in Farm Manager 2021?

items.text: • 3 new Campaigns
• 8 new scenarios
• 3 multiplayer scenarios
• Regions of the world (Europe, Central America, Asia)
--> Various climate, terrain, vegetation
--> Changed some buildings look based on region
• Fields and work in the fields
--> More metrics for fields: soil class, pH, nitrogen levels.
--> Crop rotation
--> Connecting/disconnecting fields
--> Possibility of automatic mechanical/manual operation or independent selection of vehicles and workers
--> Ability to add workers to ongoing field work
• Crops
--> 80 crop species (32 new)
--> Plants compedium
• Animals
--> Cyclic ordering/selling of animals
--> Young animals
--> 20 species of animals (3 new +2)
--> Distinguishing between laying and meat hens
-->Distinguishing between dairy and meat cows
• Vehicles
--> 35 refreshed vehicles and machines (new orchard tractor)
--> Fuel
• Manufacturing plants
--> New processing plants including biorefinery
--> Many new product types
--> Ability to create more production lines
• Multiplayer
--> Exchange of products and machines
--> Collaborative completion of scenario objectives
--> Shared free game
• Employees
--> Changed skills system
--> New look
--> Choosing if employee can be a driver
• Mods support
• Planning mode for creating farm layout
• Trading Contracts
• More leasing options
• Help Center
• Logistic system
• Resource orders in warehouses
• New trainings
• Refreshed and expanded interface
• Improved graphics and optimization

notes.title: In today's update, your farms will be joined by....

items.text: cute, adorable, charming young animals!
We hope that these fluffy little creatures will add some sunshine to the current autumn aura outside the windows.
You'll find the full changelog below.
added young animal variants for every animal with visible adult model
fixed several plants, including Black Currant, Gooseberry and Strawberry, not being planted correctly in Glasshouse, reverting Field to Plowing stage
reduced soil survey cost per tile from 250 to 25. This experimental change has been made to encourage its use
staff will now ignore how many abilities they have when calculating base wage
We are not slowing down and are already preparing more updates
Our warmest hugs,
Cleversan Team
Apiary is now available in the Asia Campaign (Chapter 1)
increased capacity in Logistics Building from 25000 to 50000
Staff working in the Logistics building will move their inventory through teleportation to it when loading a save
fixed tooltip showing blockers in Multiplayer scenarios being visible after selecting one
fixed resources being sometimes visible in Market for sale when amount was 0
fixed few decorations having holes when displayed in Preview
added new Warning: "Not enough space in logistics". It will appear over Owner's House when available capacity is less than 10% of maximum.
reduced days to expire from 1825 to 90 for manure and liquid manure.

Manure and Liquid Manure are now exempted from "Resources in building expire soon" warning.: Manure being low price resource, produced in large quantities, often clogged logistics. Those changes are trying to address that issue.
Fix for some cases of delivery truck stuck in logistic building
Fix for lower amout of harvested grass on each harvested
Increased pineapple juice price
Dear Farm Manager Enjoyers!
We've just released a major game update. Update your game, and you will find the following new features:
a new Region: Asia – high temperatures, higher rainfall and even higher opportunities.
a new Campaign: Asia – a traditional farm in a remote province… As a financial crisis looms, scale up and stay afloat, allying with local farmers.
Vietnamese Pot-Bellied Pigs, Bamboo farming, and Bamboo processed food added to the game.
new Achievements. Unlock them when progressing the Asia Campaign.
new Trading Partners, specific to Asia.
Cleversan Games Discord
7 new Avatars for Steam community (Steam will randomly pick 5 for you to choose from).
a new orange Creature that enjoys walking on keyboardsjlkjionhuoiphuihnuip;nhe
improved the tooltip in MainMenu when selecting a multiplayer Scenario to provide information about tasks and blocked features.
improved Staff behaviour during manual fertilizing. If a worker runs out of fertilizer, they will take more fertilizer as needed.
improved how Machines (particularly Tractors) are selected for Field work. Now Orchard Tractor can be selected if it meets the power requirement.
Soil Layer will now be automatically enabled when placing a Glasshouse (note that Soil Class still does not affect it).
updated the Help Center
changed how the selected food in Animal Buildings is saved.
Due to potential compatbility issues, you will see a one-time warning when loading a save, informing about this issue.
Additionally, some food will be selected to reduce the danger of animal starvation.
changed the coverage of "Select trading partner" button to include the "Selected partner".
changed Bread to be counted in as units instead of in weight.
changed Bakery price from 408 000 to 120 000.
changed machines used in Red Beans harvest due to the removal of multiharvest property.
changed some textures in both crates and Chest Trailers when transporting plant resources.

increased harvest yields on all plants to make them more profitable. (The change has been made to make plant based farms more competetive in comparison to mass animal husbandry. New values are subject to change if logistic issues start to crop up.)
changed Delivery Truck capacity from 10000 to 15000 (affects the Logistic Building).
increased the harvest multiplier from Orchard and Plants abilities from 125% to 150%.
increased the Seasonal Staff multiplier from 75% to 100%

reduced base Seasonal Staff wage to 600 from 1200. (Seasonal Staff were underutilised due to having lower efficiency than Machine farming. This change aims to reduce cost of running farms using larger workforce with lower Machine count.)
changed Wage multiplier on difficulty settings from 75% (Easy), 150% (Hard) and 200% (Extreme) to 80% (Easy), 125% (Hard), 150% (Extreme).
changed Fuel multiplier on difficulty settings from 120% (Hard) and 150% (Extreme) to 133% (Hard) and 200% (Extreme).

changed both Yield size and Price of products multiplier on difficulty settings from 85% (Hard) and 70% (Extreme) to 90% (Hard) and 80% (Extreme). (Due to multiplicative nature, old values caused income from fields to be 72% (Hard) and 49% (Extreme) of Normal difficulty income (100%). Current values are 81% (Hard) and 64% (Extreme). Those changes were made to make Extreme more manageable while still providing challenge. We are considering adding the ability to customize those values by players in the future. Send comments on Steam Forum if you would like to see such an addition.)
changed prices on several products.
when selecting crop rotation on a Field, Organic (BIO) checkbox will be on if Field is currently Organic.
removed unnecessary warning when demolishing a Pump that maintains irrigation on a Field if that Field has another Pump in range.
removed the requirement for unlocking Middle America Campaign, you can now access it even if you have not finished the European Campaign.
fixed Staff and Machines being stuck in the Owner's House due to floating point error when retrieving Resources.
fixed Staff being stuck on Field after finishing harvest. Error would occur on Fields with crop rotation after switching to Plant that produces Hay.
fixed CampaignInfoPanel (where Tom or Miguel resides) covering too much of the Field Modal.
fixed the Gas Station paying for 1 unit of Fuel when ordering lagre amounts of fuel instead, ripping the fuel vendor off in the proccess.
fixed "No resource order" warning lingering after deleting a building that created this warning.
fixed sometimes not being able to start manual fertilizing through Field Work Modal, even if free Staff number was equal to the number of Staff needed.
fixed some Production Resources not being visible in the "Produces" section when hovering on Production Buildings in the Build Menu.
fixed Grass not being visible in a Self-Loading Trailer.
fixed "Available in later part of campaign" message not being visible on the Start Training Button.
fixed several texts being blurry in the UI.
fixed demand indicators in the lower left corner showing resources from the incorrect pool.
other smaller fixes.
updated localization files.
Get in the tractor, take a Vietnamese Pot-Bellied Pig with you and join us as our Farm Manager World journey contiunes.
More updates coming soon!
Yours,
Cleversan Games Team
